meta.changelog: v2 (gap-fill): +2 channels ([P]rehab, Mark Wildman), gaps filled, uncertain close variants re-checked by oEmbed title + watch-page description; backup of v1 in data/exercise-videos.pre-gapfill.json
meta.method: Candidates came from YouTube search-results and channel-search pages for each exercise name, limited to the channel list below. Each pick was reviewed by title; one video may serve several close variants. No video IDs were typed from memory. Gaps are left as confidence 'none'.
meta.verification: Every video_id: oEmbed GET returned 200, author_name matches an allowed channel, and the watch page reports playableInEmbed=true. title/channel come from oEmbed; duration_s from the watch page lengthSeconds. Re-check with tools/check_exercise_videos.py --online.
meta.display_note: Technique demos from third-party channels; shown as links/embeds on the Learn page. No medical claims.

channels.name: Renaissance Periodization
channels.why: Dr Mike Israetel's team; largest library of short single-exercise demo clips plus hypertrophy technique videos

channels.name: Jeff Nippard
channels.why: Evidence-based coach; short 'perfect technique' tutorials for the main lifts

channels.name: Squat University
channels.why: Dr Aaron Horschig (physical therapist); squat, hinge, kettlebell and core technique

channels.name: Alan Thrall (Untamed Strength)
channels.why: Plain-spoken barbell technique tutorials (press, row, kettlebell front squat)

channels.name: FitnessFAQs
channels.why: Daniel Vadnal; calisthenics, rings and skill progressions not covered by the gym channels

channels.name: [P]rehab
channels.why: Added in gap-fill v2: The Prehab Guys, a team of licensed physical therapists posting short, clearly cued demos of band/cable hip work, anti-rotation core, plyometric and med-ball drills, calf and suspension-trainer work - the categories the five gym channels did not cover. Low-hype, single-exercise clips. Display name on YouTube is '[P]rehab'.

channels.name: Mark Wildman
channels.why: Added in gap-fill v2: kettlebell coach (Wildman Athletica) with long-running, step-by-step kettlebell technique tutorials (clean, press, push press, snatch, windmill, halo, rows) and clear front/side demos; filled the kettlebell gaps none of the other channels covered.
